description: This file defines the AppConfigDataClient class for interacting with the AWS AppConfig Data service in PHP, including method signatures for configuration retrieval and session management.

classes.name: AppConfigDataClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS AppConfig Data service, extending AwsClient, providing methods to interact with AppConfig Data API.

methods.name: getLatestConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the latest configuration data from AWS AppConfig Data service.

methods.name: getLatestConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest configuration data.

methods.name: startConfigurationSession
methods.description: Starts a new configuration session with AWS AppConfig Data service.

methods.name: startConfigurationSessionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a new configuration session.
